content.title: About
content.content: Cooked noodles are a ready‑to‑eat product made from wheat or rice flour that becomes soft and springy after boiling. They are a staple in Asian cuisine, serving as the base for soups, salads, and quick‑cook dishes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Noodles typically cook in 2–5 minutes depending on thickness and type.
There are over 200 varieties of noodles, including egg, udon, soba and rice noodles.
Traditional Japanese udon is made from wheat flour, while soba is made from buckwheat.
In China, cold noodles are a popular summer dish, dressed with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Noodles can be fortified with vitamins and minerals during processing.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Noodles provide a quick source of energy thanks to their high complex carbohydrate content.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Most cooked noodles contain little fat, making them suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Contains iron and B‑vitamins
items.content: Wheat noodles are rich in iron and vitamins B1, B2, which support metabolism.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: The soft texture of cooked noodles aids digestion, especially for mild gastrointestinal issues.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Noodles can raise blood sugar quickly, so people with diabetes should monitor portion sizes.

items.title: Gluten content
items.content: Wheat noodles contain gluten and are unsuitable for those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Added salt
items.content: Some pre‑flavored noodles contain added salt, which may be a concern for hypertension.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Boil noodles in salted water for 2–5 minutes, then rinse with cold water. They can be added to soups, tossed in sauces, used in salads, or served as a quick‑cook base.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store dry noodles in a cool, dry place in an airtight container. Cooked noodles should be kept in the refrigerator for no more than 2–3 days in a sealed container.
